You can follow the guide to change Thunderbird's date format: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/customize-date-time-formats-thunderbird

If you have set your system date to UK already, it will be simpler: ≡ > Preferences > General > Language & Appearance > Date and Time Formatting > () Application locale: Englis (US) (•) Regional settings locale: English (UK)

Otherwise, you need install/change Thunderbird to use English (UK) package.
